notes.title: Version 1.18
notes.content: I made some changes that should actually fix the locale issue stated in V1.17. I didn't know until months later that the previous 'fix' didn't actually work.

notes.title: V1.16 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now there's a "Save & Quit" option when using an Inn. Loading a saved yomp or starting a new yomp, will discard the saved yomp.
[*] The game now has a custom cursor.
[*] The game now has a custom loading splash image.
[*] The Sling weapon's description was reworded to be more clear that it requires rocks to be used.
[*] Some text sizes were altered.
[/list]
